purpose: Implement one scoped test-only research card using pristine measurements and a retained proposal; never change the production solver.

execution.instructions: Candidate measurements run after the join; pending configured measurement alone is not a blocker. Apply only the obligations assigned to this card; preserve actual predecessor collector work, and hand off runnable test-side source without claiming pending proof passed. Read original request, assigned task/paths, dependency manifest, pin feedback and all baseline/prior_patch/checks artifacts. Prior_patch is proposal/reference data copied to an owned evidence file; the host did not restore it. Reuse only this card’s test/docs hunks with apply_patch in this ordinary coding turn; preserve predecessor work and prior findings. Stop on incompatible base/contexts rather than force or rebase. Stay strictly inside declared write paths. Research evidence only; no engine optimization or product-fix claim. Follow request, AGENTS.md and docs/testing.md. Read full baseline, scoped checks and measurement artifacts, including exact selected test/package outcomes. Baseline stdout must cover the original six controls; baseline collector sidecars are not required. Candidate structured evidence remains mandatory. Change only test-side collectors/regressions and concise research findings; preserve production algorithms, RNG/order, pruning, grading, identities, validation, work/cancellation limits and the single 10-second request deadline. Preserve existing release tests/benchmarks and all six controls. Require fresh engine/generator per sample, no cache hits, actual nonzero bounded work and one deadline across seed rounds; distinguish native work from total request work. Implement the separately selected opt-in research benchmark only when assigned by this card. Record expected bounded rejection/deadline/not-reproduced outcomes as complete structured JSON DATA; broken setup, invariants or incomplete collection remain failures. Missing sidecars or truncated stdout are incomplete evidence. Configured steps execute checks/measurement; do not run them, Git, agents or external work. Use the deadline; hand off a runnable collector before drawing conclusions. Material scope/capability blockers return blocked. Keep summary <=240 characters; no workflow, permission or limit changes. Independent review may accept complete NOT_REPRODUCED evidence; do not manufacture a product fix, hide failed samples or claim prior conclusions as current proof. Internal pinning is not review approval. No integration, publication, deployment, new agents or permissions.
